mapper.select: SELECT pv.id,pv.workspace_id,pv.scene,pv.version_no,pv.system_prompt,pv.status,pv.updated_at FROM prompt_versions pv JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=pv.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' WHERE pv.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} ORDER BY pv.updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE prompt_versions SET version_no=#{versionNo},system_prompt=#{systemPrompt},status=#{status},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId}
